fusions.name: Cold Bar Swing
fusions.desc: Swings a rigid arm that deals 14 damage and stuns the target for 1.2 seconds, rising to 1.5 times that at the full 5 tiles.

fusions.name: Corroding Spray
fusions.desc: Sprays a cone of brine 5 tiles ahead, dealing 4 damage to everything in it, with a 30% chance to leave each target [Sundered] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Hull Held Tight
fusions.desc: Raises a barrier that absorbs the next 30 damage and holds for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Cold Blood
fusions.desc: Your armour rises by 15% and you resist 10% of physical damage.
